Package com.hiface.sdk.flow

Enum FaceFlowOutcome

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<FaceFlowOutcome>
com.hiface.sdk.flow.FaceFlowOutcome
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<FaceFlowOutcome>
public enum FaceFlowOutcome extends java.lang.Enum<FaceFlowOutcome>
Business outcomes for liveness and dynamic 1:1 verification. Check isPassed() first, then distinguish rejection and timeout reasons. Processing errors use onError. Continuous search uses the separate FaceSearchResult.EndReason. New values are appended; include a default branch in application switches.

  • Enum Constant Details

    • PASSED

      public static final FaceFlowOutcome PASSED
      Passed. Liveness passed if performed, and identity similarity reached the threshold if compared.

    • NOT_MATCHED

      public static final FaceFlowOutcome NOT_MATCHED
      The flow completed, but its highest similarity did not reach the configured threshold. Applies only to dynamic 1:1 or combined verification; standalone liveness does not compare identities.

    • SPOOF_DETECTED

      public static final FaceFlowOutcome SPOOF_DETECTED
      The real-face score from passive liveness is below the decision threshold.

    • NO_FACE_TIMEOUT

      public static final FaceFlowOutcome NO_FACE_TIMEOUT
      No eligible face appeared within the time limit.

    • FACE_LOST

      public static final FaceFlowOutcome FACE_LOST
      The selected face remained absent until the SDK's time limit.

    • MULTIPLE_FACES

      public static final FaceFlowOutcome MULTIPLE_FACES
      Two or more eligible faces persisted until the SDK's time limit.

    • ACTION_TIMEOUT

      public static final FaceFlowOutcome ACTION_TIMEOUT
      The action sequence did not complete within its overall time limit.

    • FINAL_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT

      public static final FaceFlowOutcome FINAL_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT
      No eligible final image was obtained by the hard deadline. The timeout depends on the flow type.
